tasks.text: Give her a 30-second hug and one sincere compliment.
Take her hand and invite her to a slow dance.
Lead a three-minute romantic ritual while she relaxes into the moment.
Whisper one detail you genuinely admire about her.
Share a bold wish that feels good for both of you, then gently set the pace.
Choose the music for a focused moment that belongs only to you two.

punishments.text: Fate penalty: swap positions with her!
